Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from New Zealand's quick tour of the Netherlands. As expected, the scoreline is 2-0. Now, the Black Caps will fly to West Indies for a 3-match ODI and T20I series. As far as the Dutch team is concerned, Pakistan are expected to visit them for a 3-match ODI series in August. We look forward to your company in future. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers.

Mitchell Santner, the Kiwi skipper, says that the pitch played a lot better and the New Zealand bowlers bowled quite smartly. Mentions that they got off to a good start and then carried it forward. Shares that he promoted himself to number 3 to counter the left-arm spinners and it worked well for them. Praises Bas de Leede for his knock. Tells that the intent his team showed throughout the chase was amazing and praises Daryl Mitchell for his knock. Mentions that the team is in good spirits and is looking forward to the next challenge in West Indies.

Scott Edwards, the Dutch skipper, says that 160 could have been a par score but admits that the way they bowled and fielded, they are not sure what a good score would have been on this surface. Tells that you can't afford to misfield and drop catches against a top team. Praises Bas de Leede and says that he has been sensational for them for the last year or so. Feels that this is the sort of cricket they want to be playing in their build-up to the T20 World Cup.
Presentation coming up...

The Black Caps were below-par in both the departments of the game in the first T20I but showed vast improvement. Their bowlers were brilliant in the Powerplay and then at the death to restrict the Netherlands to a gettable total. Mitchell Santner will be delighted with the way the team responded and they will look to carry the same momentum forward.

Chasing a target of 148, New Zealand did lose their openers cheaply but Mitchell Santner promoted himself at number three and along with Daryl Mitchell, he raised an unbeaten century stand to overhaul the target with utmost ease. Santner showed his prowess with the bat to notch up his maiden fifty in T20Is and finished with a 42-ball 77. His knock was studded with nine fours and four biggies. Mitchell played a lovely supporting role and towards the end, he opened his arms and hammered a few lusty blows to take New Zealand home at a canter.

Total domination! What an outstanding batting performance by the Kiwis! They were off-colour in the first game but turned up with full force in this one and decimated the Dutch team. A win with six overs to spare - ruthless!

FOUR! NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 8 WICKETS! Ryan Klein delivers it on a length around off, Daryl Mitchell swings his bat firmly and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Brings up his fifty as well with the winning shot.
Bowls it on middle, Daryl Mitchell flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller and around leg, Daryl Mitchell looks to flick it but the ball hits his pads.

SIX! Action replay of the previous shot. Fuller again, outside off, Mitchell latches onto it and once again launches it behind the bowler for a biggie. This one has also gone into the water. 5 needed more.

SIX! Out of the stadium! In the arc and it's out of the park. Fuller in length, around off, Mitchell gives it the full whack of his bat and hoists it over the bowler's head for a maximum. The ball has gone into the water outside the stadium. New ball, please!
On a length and on leg, Daryl Mitchell looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits his upper thigh. A slight appeal from the keeper but the umpire is uninterested.
Slower and just outside off, Mitchell Santner swings his bat to play at it but misses.
Shorter and on middle, Mitchell Santner looks to pull it but misses.
Fuller one this time, Mitchell Santner flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
A yorker around leg, Santner does well to dig it out safely on the leg side.
SIX! Santner is on fire! Slower delivery, on a length around off, Santner picks up the variation and pumps it over long off for a biggie. The century stand comes up.

FOUR! Santner gets lucky this time! Fuller in length, around off and angling in, Santner clears his front leg to play the heave over the leg side but it takes the inner edge, beats the stumps and scoots away to the fine leg fence.
Logan van Beek is back into the attack.

Outside off and fuller in length, Mitchell Santner shuffles across and slaps it towards backward point. Bas de Leede just manages to stop it before the fence by diving to his right. They get three runs.
DROPPED AND SIX! Another short delivery, outside off and turning away, Santner whacks it aerially towards deep cover where Bas de Leede jumps to catch it but spills it over the fence.
FOUR! Smashed! A googly, on the shorter side around off, Mitchell Santner goes on the back foot and slaps it over Vikramjit Singh at extra cover for a boundary.
Slower and outside off, Mitchell Santner looks to play at it but misses.
Fuller one this time, Daryl Mitchell flicks it to mid-wicket for one again.
Tossed up, giving it some air, Mitchell Santner drives it to deep cover for one.
Change of ends for Shariz Ahmad.
FOUR! Daryl Mitchell moves to 32. Another quicker one, full and around off, Daryl Mitchell once again plays a reverse-batted shot to perfection and beats backward point. 44 needed off 54 balls.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's eased down to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, full and outside off, Santner swishes and misses.
Flighted and around middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Mitchell Santner drives it to long off for one. Maiden T20I fifty for Santner, off just 29 balls.
Flatter and on middle, Daryl Mitchell hits it towards long on for one.
Change in bowling. Scott Edwards is taking a punt on Tom Cooper.
FOUR! Pure timing! Fuller in length, around leg, Santner steps back a bit to create room and punches it sweetly over wide mid off for a boundary. 52 needed more at the halfway mark.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Mitchell Santner looks to hit it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces back towards the bowler.
This one lands outside off and fuller in length, Daryl Mitchell hammers it down to long on for a single.
Goes fuller this time, Mitchell Santner slices it towards extra cover for one.
Shorter and outside off, Mitchell Santner looks to play at it but it bounces over his blade.
On a length and down the middle, Mitchell Santner defends it back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Put away by Mitchell. Floated one, full and around off, Daryl Mitchell brings out the reverse sweep and unveils it wide of short third man for a boundary.

PUT DOWN! A tough catch though. Tossed up, around off, Mitchell Santner tries to hammer it over the leg side but it takes the top edge and flies behind the bowler. Pringle tracks back to attempt the catch but only manages fingertips. A single is taken.
Drifting it into the pads, this is flicked towards square leg for one more.
Tossed up on middle, Mitchell Santner flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off again, Mitchell Santner drives it to deep cover for one.
Tossed up outside off, Daryl Mitchell steers it to deep point and takes a single.
Tim Pringle is back into the attack.
On a length and on off, slower too, Mitchell Santner looks to play at it but misses. 9 from the over, 68 needed off 72 balls.
Fuller one on off, Daryl Mitchell drives it to long off and rotates the strike.
Slightly shorter one this time, Daryl Mitchell pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
On off, Mitchell Santner guides it to short third man for one.

On a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge and the ball bounces back on the surface. They take a quick single. The bowler chases it and scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Santner is well in. The 50-run stand comes up in quick time.
FOUR! Boundaries are coming thick and fast for New Zealand!​ Ryan Klein dishes out a low full toss, on middle, Mitchell shows the full face of his bat and spanks it down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! 10 runs from the final two deliveries. Captain's knock! Full and flighted again, outside off, this time Santner smashes it over covers and finds the fence. New Zealand are cruising.
SIX! Santner is going full monty! Loopy and full, around off, Santner sits down on one knee and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slightly shorter one, Daryl Mitchell uses his feet and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls it on off, Mitchell Santner punches it to long off for one.
Darts it on middle, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Flatter one on off, Daryl Mitchell clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Shariz Ahmad to bowl after the field restriction is relaxed.
FOUR! 58 for 2 after six, a superb Powerplay for the Kiwis. A full toss this time outside off, Santner stays leg-side of this delivery and forces it through covers. 90 needed off 84 balls!
Play and a miss! Slower one, full and outside off, Santner flashes his bat at it but fails to connect.
Fires it flat and short around middle and leg, Santner goes back and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! Streaky! Flighted and full, outside off, Santner goes hard at it and edges it past short third man for a boundary. The skipper is doing his promotion full justice.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short in length and outside off, Santner camps back and packs a punch through covers for a boundary.

Shout for an lbw, not given! Full and flighted, just outside off, Mitchell tries to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads, it deflects towards short fine leg and they cross. The impact was the issue.
Fractionally short and on off, Mitchell bunts it down in front of mid on and pinches a single. An unlucky over for Logan van Beek, he ends up conceding 12 runs.
Slower one, it's full and around off, Mitchell drags his attempted heave off the inner edge. The ball rolls through mid-wicket and they take two.
Wide called for height! Short and around off, Mitchell leaves it as it flies over his head. Great take by the keeper!
Slower one, a bit short and on middle, Santner stays back and works it towards wide mid on for a run.
EDGY FOUR! Santner gets lucky this time. Short in length, around off, Santner tries to pull but it takes the top edge and flies behind short third man for a boundary.
Aerial but safe. Short in length, around off, Mitchell hangs on the back foot and smacks it towards mid on. It nearly carries to the fielder inside the ring. The batters cross.
Mistimed! A length ball around off, Mitchell tries to loft it straight down the ground but ends up slicing it behind extra cover. They get a couple.
Short in length around off, Mitchell helps his pull shot to deep square leg and runs the first run hard. He wants the second run but it's not on.

Shortish and on middle, Santner moves back and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end, the ball deflects and Santner eyes an overthrow but his partner is not ready.

FOUR! Hammered! Back of a length, around off and slower in pace, Santner picks it early, stays on the back foot and whacks it towards cover-point. The fielder gets a bad bounce and it races behind him for a boundary.
Edgy shot! Fuller in length and around leg, Santner tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It takes the leading edge and squirts to point.
Serves a length ball around off, angling in, Mitchell helps it with gentle hands to mid-wicket for a quick run.
Daryl Mitchell is the new batter in.

OUT! GIVEN LBW! Both the Kiwi openers are removed now. Finn Allen is not too impressed with the decision on his way back. He is looking at his bat, maybe, there was some inside edge. A length ball around off, angling in, Finn gets across the stumps a bit and tries to heave it over the leg side. He misses and is pinged on the front pad. They appeal and the finger goes up. The replays don't detect any bat. There is no DRS for this series.
Bas de Leede comes into the attack now.
Flatter and around leg, defended back. 7 from the over along with a wicket. 122 needed off 102 balls.
Quicker one, around off and skidding away, Santner stays back to hit it hard but misses. The keeper breaks the stump and appeals but nothing from the umpire standing at square leg.
The ball goes out of the park and the new ball has been brought in.

SIX! Out of here! Loopy and full, around off, Santner finds it in his zone, clears his front leg and smokes it over long on for a biggie. This is why Santner has come up the order, to take on the left-arm spinner.
Short in length and outside off, Santner cuts it off his back foot but finds Shariz Ahmad at point.
The skipper Mitchell Santner has promoted himself up in the order.

OUT! BOWLED! Tim Pringle has bounced back well after experiencing a tough time on the field in the last over. An arm ball is served, it's around off and Martin Guptill tries to defend it off the front foot. The ball though lands and straightens a hint to beat the blade of the batter. It goes on to disturb the stumps and the Netherlands have an early breakthrough.
Skidding down the leg side, Allen gets back to work it around the corner but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg and they steal a leg bye.
Tim Pringle comes into the attack.
Four leg byes! 17 from the over. Back of a length, around leg and sliding down. Guptill tries to glance but misses. It touches his thigh pad and runs wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Lands it on a good length and outside off, Allen heaves it off the inner half and it goes on one bounce to Pringle at deep square leg. They cross for a run.

FOUR! Slower one, a touch short and around off, Finn Allen goes for the full-blooded pull shot but it races off the inner half of his bat. Tim Pringle runs across to his right to make the stop at deep backward square leg but fails.
Fuller and on middle, Guptill knocks it down to the left of mid on and takes a brisk run.

DROPPED! What a costly miss! Short in length, around middle, Allen pulls it with great timing but it goes flat and straight to Tim Pringle at deep backward square leg. He spills the chance and the batters cross.
SIX! Dismissed! A friendly full toss, around off, Finn walks across the stumps and launches it deep into the stand at square leg for a biggie.
Logan van Beek to bowl from the other end.
Arm ball around off, Finn uses his feet to a full ball and drills it down to long on for one. Superb first over from Clayton Floyd.
Another dot. Flighted and around off, Finn fires his drive straight back and once again Clayton Floyd makes a fine stop in his followthrough.
Swing and a miss! Full and flighted, around off and turning away, Allen tries to heave it over the leg side but misses. The intention is quite clear from both the Kiwi openers.
Edgy! Loopy and full, around off, Guptill drags his attempted slog-sweep. It goes through square leg and they cross.
Too full this time, around middle, Martin Guptill drills it back and the bowler makes a fantastic stop in his followthrough.
Starts with a flatter arm ball, around leg, Guptill brings his bat down in time as he defends it to mid-wicket.
